title: StreamLabs Water Event Weekly Flow Duration Trend
dataSources: Whole-home water flow (`watermeter:flow`), sump pump (`sumppump:event`), well pump (`wellpump:event`), pool/spa chemistry (`pool:chemistry`), water softener (`watersoftener:status`), irrigation zones (`irrigation:zone`).
app: Smart water meters (Flume/Flo/HomeWizard), sump- and well-pump sensors, pool/spa controllers, water-softener and irrigation controllers via vendor APIs, MQTT, and HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=streamlabs:water duration_min=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(duration_min) as avg_duration, max(duration_min) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst flow duration for StreamLabs water event events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture duration_min on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average flow duration with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It times whether StreamLabs water event tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
